title: Electrical Work Order Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Electrical Work: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Electrical Work Order Completion Report covers branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area. The electrical service coordinator records Residential Electrical Work performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Electrical Work Order Completion Report keeps Residential Electrical Work exceptions visible until the electrical service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Electrical Work Order Completion Report at residence, panel, circuit, room, device, and equipment connection. Document branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area identity before Residential Electrical Work begins. Compare branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area findings with stated Residential Electrical Work criteria; route unresolved Residential Electrical Work issues to qualified electrical reviewer. For Electrical Work Order Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Electrical Work. Ask qualified electrical reviewer to review Residential Electrical Work conditions beyond the electrical service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Provider, customer, and service record
sections.guidance: For Residential Electrical Work, identify responsible parties, residence, panel, circuit, room, device, and equipment connection, and the linked branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area source.

fields.label: Panel, circuit, device, and load identifier
Reported trip, outage, heat, damage, or performance history

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Electrical Work facts for branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Electrical Work completion checks
items: De-energization and absence-of-voltage control within scope
Panel, breaker, conductor, termination, and enclosure condition
Device, receptacle, switch, fixture, and grounding observation
Load, rating, labeling, and overcurrent-protection match
Heat, odor, arcing, moisture, and physical-damage signs

sections.title: Verified outcome and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Electrical Work conditions; have electrical service coordinator assign the next Residential Electrical Work owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Service or panel condition outside authorization
Heat, arcing, damaged conductor, or moisture concern
Required permit or qualified authority unavailable
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Electrical Work when energization, grounding, overcurrent, conductor, panel, or authorization concern remains. Retain the available Residential Electrical Work proof and route unresolved branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area scope to electrical service coordinator.
